name: Mávy
author: github.com/nrbrtuwu
description: Mávy: a private MÁV / GYSEV train tracker PWA (timetable plus live delays), running on Bun. Pushes to the Git branch are deployed automatically with no downtime: the new commit is built and tested next to the live site and traffic switches over once it is healthy. Upload MÁV's GTFS zip into the data folder's gtfs/ to load or update the timetable. Put a reverse proxy with HTTPS in front of the allocation (the app installs and works offline only over HTTPS).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Mávy installation script
# Server files: /mnt/server
# This only fetches the code. deploy/supervisor.ts builds, tests and starts a release on first start
# and keeps it up to date afterwards, so a reinstall is only needed to reset the checkout.
set -e

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null

REPO="${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/nrbrtuwu/mavy.git}"
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"
DATA="${DATA_DIR:-./data}"

# A private repository needs the token. It is sent as a one-off header and never saved in the checkout.
AUTH=()
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" ]; then
    BASIC=$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" | base64 -w0)
    AUTH=(-c "http.https://github.com/.extraheader=AUTHORIZATION: basic ${BASIC}")
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Updating existing Mávy checkout from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
    git remote set-url origin "${REPO}"
    # Full history: the build number is the commit count.
    git "${AUTH[@]}" fetch --unshallow origin "${BRANCH}" 2>/dev/null || git "${AUTH[@]}" fetch origin "${BRANCH}"
    git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
else
    echo "Cloning Mávy from ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
    rm -rf /tmp/mavy
    git "${AUTH[@]}" clone --branch "${BRANCH}" "${REPO}" /tmp/mavy
    cp -a /tmp/mavy/. /mnt/server/
    rm -rf /tmp/mavy
fi

# The data folder holds the timetable database, the GTFS upload and the badge font.
# It is git ignored, so updates never touch it.
mkdir -p "${DATA}/gtfs"

# Releases are built in releases/<commit>; dependencies and builds in the root are not used.
rm -rf node_modules web/node_modules dist

test -f deploy/supervisor.ts

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Mávy installation completed"
echo "Upload MÁV's GTFS zip into ${DATA}/gtfs/ (File Manager), then press Start."
echo "The first start builds and tests the app and imports the timetable, which takes a few minutes."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: The public address of the site without a trailing slash, for example https://mavy.example.com. Used for the links in GitHub's deploy statuses; leave empty if there is none.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Shared password for the site (MAVY_PASSWORD). Leave empty when access is already limited, e.g. by Tailscale or Cloudflare Access.

variables.name: Live Delays
variables.description: Live delays from vonatinfo.mav.hu. Set to off to show planned times only.

variables.name: Data Directory
variables.description: Folder for the timetable database, the GTFS upload (gtfs/) and the badge font, relative to the server root. Reinstalling and deploys leave it untouched.

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Repository to install and update from.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to install from and deploy automatically on every push.

variables.name: GitHub Token
variables.description: Fine-grained GitHub token for this repository only. Contents: Read-only is needed because the repository is private. Add Commit statuses and Deployments: Read and write to show build status next to each commit on GitHub.

variables.name: GitHub Status
variables.description: Show build status next to each commit and a production deployment on GitHub (needs the token's Commit statuses and Deployments permissions).

variables.name: Automatic Deploys
variables.description: Deploy every push to the Git branch without downtime. Set to false to stay on the installed commit.

variables.name: Deploy Webhook Secret
variables.description: Secret of the GitHub webhook pointing at PUBLIC_URL/__deploy/github, so pushes deploy within seconds. Leave empty to rely on polling only.

variables.name: Deploy Poll Interval
variables.description: How often, in seconds, to check the branch for new commits in case a webhook is missed. 0 turns polling off.
